about: One row per language folder under Trax.StateMachine/, naming the testee each kit runs it through. A testee is a command CI runs from Trax.StateMachine/ (it appears in .github/workflows/ci.yml as written), a test that answers the kit in process (a path from the repository's root), or none, with the reason. name is what the testee runs under (--name), so its expected failures are expected-failures/<name>.json in each kit. surfaceColumn is the language's column in the client surface tables of client/PROTOCOL.md. suite is the packages.json suite whose CI job runs the engine and client kits for it. TesteeRosterTests holds this file to the folders, packages.json and ci.yml.

operations.none: trax client --operations generates TypeScript and C# only; there is no Rust operations client to test.
